summary: The focused whitespace-collapse obligation is necessary. The old harness selects the default preservation mode before and after the change, so it cannot exercise parsing with COLLAPSE_WHITESPACE.

claims.necessity_reason: XMLDocument supports COLLAPSE_WHITESPACE, and ordinary text parsing selects its collapse flag in that mode. A finite input such as x y distinguishes the supported mode, but the harness always constructs the document with the preservation default.

before.requirement: Parse ordinary XML text containing repeated whitespace with COLLAPSE_WHITESPACE selected.
before.reason: The no-argument XMLDocument constructor selects PRESERVE_WHITESPACE. Input bytes cannot change the document's whitespace mode.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Ordinary text parsing sets the whitespace-collapse flag only when the document selects COLLAPSE_WHITESPACE.
The flag supports a distinct normalized text value.
The selected change group concerns cleanup of parsed nodes.

after.requirement: Parse ordinary XML text containing repeated whitespace with COLLAPSE_WHITESPACE selected.
after.reason: The supported mode remains available, while the same old harness still uses the no-argument constructor and therefore selects PRESERVE_WHITESPACE.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Ordinary text parsing still sets the whitespace-collapse flag only for COLLAPSE_WHITESPACE.
The flag still supports a distinct normalized text value.
The selected change group alters cleanup of parsed nodes.

claims.comparison_reason: The same fixed constructor prevents selection of COLLAPSE_WHITESPACE on both sides. XMLText::ParseDeep sets a flag; normalization of the text value occurs when that value is read.
